_comment: DECODE-GRANULARITY PROBE, arm 1 of 3. Single-variable change from shape_prior/lizard_heatmap_baseline.json: heatmap_size 128 -> 64, with model.sigma scaled 5.0 -> 2.5 and decode_radius 5 -> 3 so the target width and the decode window keep the same PHYSICAL size (8 canvas px per cell at hm64, so 2.5 cells = 20 canvas px, matching 5 cells at hm128). This is the COARSE arm and it is the most informative one: it is cheap, and if error at 64 is materially worse than at 128 then grid granularity demonstrably costs accuracy on this dataset, which is the premise SimCC rests on. Arm 2 is probe_heatmap_hm256.json; arm 3 is shape_prior/lizard_heatmap_baseline.json unchanged.
